I also believe that perceptual experiences provide us with justification for our perceptual beliefs about the external world. In my spare time I like to go hiking and play tennis. What is your view on the following topic: Perceptual experience
 (A) sense-datum theory
 (B) representationalism
 (C) qualia theory
 (D) disjunctivism
